## instruments — find instruments and read tick size, multiplier, currency

Does: Searches the terminal's instrument catalog and returns contract details for an InstrumentId.
Needs: A search text or an InstrumentId.

Calls on `IInstruments`:
- `Instrument? Find(InstrumentId instrument)` — Contract details for one instrument, or null when it is unknown.
- `IReadOnlyList<Instrument> Search(string text, int max = 20)` — Instruments whose symbol or name matches `text`, best match first.

Types:
- `Instrument(InstrumentId Id, string CanonicalSymbol, AssetClass AssetClass, string Exchange, string Currency, double TickSize, double Multiplier)` — The canonical, broker-neutral description of a tradable instrument.
- `AssetClass: Unknown | Equity | Future | Forex | Crypto | Option | Index` — Broker-neutral asset classification for a canonical instrument.

Limits: Only instruments the terminal knows about; an external market (e.g. a prediction market) is fetched with the network block instead.
